note: Required external decisions for MC-14. None may be made by an autonomous agent. No option is selected, no permission is granted, no provider or authority has been contacted, and no legal clearance is implied. A decision is CLOSED only when the named external artefact exists.

decisions.title: Appoint qualified Spanish/EU counsel for market placement, liability and consumer law
decisions.question: Which qualified counsel will confirm the applicable market-placement duties, product-liability exposure (including Directive (EU) 2024/2853 and its Spanish transposition), consumer terms and the remediation route for each MAREA family?
options: Spanish law firm with EU product-regulation practice
EU-level firm with Spanish desk
Specialist marine/consumer counsel retained per workstream
decisions.recommendation: Retain one accountable counsel for the market-placement and liability workstream before any product is offered.
evidenceToClose: Counsel opinion on scope and open questions

decisions.title: Choose the economic-operator model per supply scenario
decisions.question: For own-branded hardware, imported white-label hardware, third-party certified modules, Raspberry Pi appliances, Pico controllers, installer-supplied systems and hosted services, will EMBARCARTE be manufacturer, importer, distributor, seller, installer, SaaS provider or a combination?
options: EMBARCARTE is legal manufacturer for all own-branded hardware
OEM/white-label supplier remains manufacturer and EMBARCARTE is importer/distributor
Mixed model, documented per SKU and supplier
decisions.recommendation: Mixed model, decided per SKU and recorded in the economic-operator matrix and supplier contracts.

decisions.title: Resolve OPEN-MARINE ownership chain and contributor rights
decisions.question: Which entity owns OPEN-MARINE, which contributors must assign or waive rights, and what documentary chain proves EMBARCARTE may commercialise, sublicense and distribute the code and firmware?
options: Full assignment to EMBARCARTE by all contributors and the custodian entity
Exclusive licence to EMBARCARTE with documented scope
Abandon the disputed code and rebuild the affected components
decisions.recommendation: Full assignment or exclusive licence before any distribution; do not rely on repository custody.

decisions.title: Choose the OPEN-MARINE outbound licence and distribution position
decisions.question: Is the MAREA product proprietary, permissive or source-available, and how are third-party notices, source-provision and firmware distribution handled under that choice?
options: Proprietary baseline after assignments
Permissive/open-source distribution
Source-available/dual licensing
decisions.recommendation: Proprietary baseline for MAREA products, with a documented third-party notice and compliance pack.

decisions.title: Commission MAREA trademark clearance and decide public brand use
decisions.question: Is MAREA registrable and clear for the intended goods/services in the EU and Spain, and what MC-14 rule supersedes the MC-03 class-A public-brand allowance while clearance is NOT_GRANTED?
options: Commission EUIPO/OEPM clearance and file
Rename the brand
Keep MAREA internal-only indefinitely
decisions.recommendation: Commission clearance; keep MAREA_PUBLIC_USE = NO_GO until a registration or written clearance exists.

decisions.title: Choose the chart/ENC licensing strategy
decisions.question: Will NAV pursue official ENC distribution (IHM/IC-ENC/OEM), use user-supplied charts only, or partner with a chart provider?
options: Pursue official ENC distribution agreement
User-supplied charts with no official-chart claim
Partner with a licensed chart provider
decisions.recommendation: User-supplied charts initially, with explicit navigation-aid disclaimers, unless an ENC agreement is funded.
evidenceToClose: Signed licence or explicit user-supplied-chart policy

decisions.title: Choose the weather data provider strategy
decisions.question: Will WEATHER use a paid commercial licence, a self-hosted AGPL stack, or a public-sector agreement, and which display/cache/redistribution rights are granted?
options: Paid commercial provider
Self-hosted AGPL stack with compliance analysis
Public-sector agreement (AEMET/MeteoGalicia/Puertos)
decisions.recommendation: Paid commercial provider with explicit display, cache and offline terms.
evidenceToClose: Signed provider licence or written public-sector terms

decisions.title: Choose the AIS decoder and receiver strategy
decisions.question: Will AIS-catcher (GPL-3.0) be shipped with full compliance, replaced by a permissively licensed decoder, or user-installed, and which receiver module evidences radio conformity?
options: Ship AIS-catcher with full GPL compliance
Replace with a permissive decoder
User-installed decoder with documented separation
decisions.recommendation: Replace or user-install the decoder; select a receiver module with existing conformity evidence.
evidenceToClose: GPL compliance pack or replacement licence

decisions.title: Decide NMEA 2000 participation
decisions.question: Will EMBARCARTE license NMEA 2000 and certify products, or support only NMEA 0183/Signal K with tested interoperability?
options: License and certify NMEA 2000
NMEA 0183/Signal K only
Third-party certified NMEA gateway module
decisions.recommendation: NMEA 0183/Signal K only until a business case and licence exist.

decisions.title: Fund or defer the PILOT safety programme
decisions.question: Will EMBARCARTE fund the staged safety programme (bench, HIL, supervised sea trials, independent assessment) or defer PILOT indefinitely?
options: Fund the staged programme
Defer PILOT
Partner with a certified autopilot vendor
decisions.recommendation: Defer PILOT and keep the safety gate BLOCKED until the programme is funded.
evidenceToClose: Independent safety report and sea-trial evidence

decisions.title: Choose the hardware manufacturing and supply model
decisions.question: Will EMBARCARTE design and contract-manufacture, OEM/white-label, or partner for each hardware family, and who is the legal manufacturer?
options: Design and contract manufacture
OEM/white-label
Partner with an established manufacturer
decisions.recommendation: Per-family decision documented with the supplier contract and the economic-operator matrix.

decisions.title: Obtain product liability, cyber and professional-indemnity insurance
decisions.question: Which broker and insurer will quote cover for the intended product scope, territories and PILOT/cyber exposure, and at what premium, limits and exclusions?
options: Broker indication now, bind only before first placement
Bind a limited pilot policy
Self-insure/defer with explicit residual-risk acceptance
decisions.recommendation: Obtain a broker indication before any launch decision; keep the premium UNKNOWN until quoted.

decisions.title: Authorize the payment, merchant and tax model
decisions.question: Which hosted/tokenised provider, merchant account, SCA model, refund/chargeback regime and VAT/OSS/import treatment will be used, and who confirms the tax position?
options: Single hosted provider with tax adviser confirmation
Provider plus separate subscription-billing layer
Defer commerce until the entity and terms are ready
decisions.recommendation: Defer commerce; when authorized, use one hosted/tokenised provider and obtain professional tax confirmation.

decisions.title: Decide the privacy operating model, DPIA and processor agreements
decisions.question: What are EMBARCARTE's controller/processor roles per purpose, does FLEET require a full DPIA, which subprocessors are used, and who is the DPO/contact?
options: Appoint an internal DPO and contract processors
External DPO service
Reduce processing scope to lower-risk purposes
decisions.recommendation: Appoint an accountable privacy lead, run the DPIA and contract processors before any WATCH/FLEET processing.

decisions.title: Decide CRA classification, support period and conformity route
decisions.question: Is each product family a default, important or critical product, what support period applies, which conformity-assessment route is used, and how are updates and incident reporting operated?
options: Self-assessment for default products
Third-party assessment for important/critical products
Reduce functionality to remain default class
decisions.recommendation: Classify per family with counsel/notified body; adopt an explicit support-period policy.

decisions.title: Approve the consumer, B2B, subscription and installer contract set
decisions.question: Which counsel-reviewed templates will govern consumer sales, B2B supply, subscriptions, returns/RMA and installer/distributor relationships?
options: Single counsel-reviewed template set with annexes
Separate consumer/B2B/installer sets drafted by specialists
Defer sale and keep the site non-transactional
decisions.recommendation: Separate consumer and B2B sets with installer and subscription annexes, approved before any sale.

decisions.title: Provide legal identity and authorize website commerce remediation
decisions.question: What are the registered company name, tax ID, address and registry data, and who authorizes the legal-identity, cookie and commerce-surface remediation?
options: Complete identity now and publish the legal pack
Publish identity only and disable commerce
Keep the site non-commercial until entity data is ready
decisions.recommendation: Complete identity and disable or clearly label non-MAREA sample commerce before any publication.

decisions.title: Authorize claims-policy publication and website/SEO remediation
decisions.question: Who approves the MC-14 claims policy, the bilingual claims catalogue and the future MC-15 website/SEO remediation, and under which release gates?
options: Programme Lead approves internal governance, counsel approves public copy
External counsel pre-approves every public claim
No public claims until launch readiness
decisions.recommendation: Programme Lead approves internal governance; public copy waits for evidence and MC-15 gate.

decisions.title: Register as a producer and evidence environmental compliance
decisions.question: Which WEEE, RoHS, battery and packaging producer obligations apply, which registration numbers are required in Spain, and who operates take-back and reporting?
options: Register directly with each Spanish producer scheme
Use a compliance take-back organisation
Manufacturer/importer bears the registration
decisions.recommendation: Register before first placement and collect supplier RoHS/material declarations.

decisions.title: Authorize any future commercial launch (outside MC-14 scope)
decisions.question: After every release gate closes, who authorizes the first commercial offer, and on which product/territory/price/terms?
options: Company owner authorization through MC-36 release gate
Phased pilot with named customers under contract
No launch until external validation exists
decisions.recommendation: No launch decision is taken in MC-14. The decision belongs to the future release milestone and requires all gates CLOSED_VERIFIED.
